lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke runs until he can't run anymore. When he finally stops, he realizes he's completely lost.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Where... where am I? How did I get here?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The city around him is massive, unfamiliar, and overwhelming.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I need to find help. I need to find Professor Layton.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But who can I ask? Everyone is in such a hurry...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke watches the crowd, feeling more alone than ever.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Maybe... maybe I should just give up. I can't do this alone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Just then, Luke notices something odd.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Is that... a boy climbing through a window?

lines.speaker: boy
lines.text: Hey! You! Yeah, you! Come here!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: boy
lines.text: Yeah! I need your help! Quick!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Finally, someone who needs me!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke rushes over, not realizing what he's getting himself into.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait... did we just... steal that?

lines.speaker: boy
lines.text: Steal? We LIBERATED it! Buying stuff is for wimps!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: No, that's wrong! We should pay for things!

lines.speaker: boy
lines.text: Whatever, man. I'm outta here!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait! I don't even know your name!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The boy disappears into the crowd.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Great. Now I'm alone again. And possibly a criminal.
